proposals.evidence: Section 1 chagala includes Oriya cheḷi and Bihari/Hindi cherī “goat”, in the same chēla family. These eastern survey ceṛi/ceḍī responses match that feminine goat series with loss or variation of aspiration and the source’s retroflex/flap notation retained. The link leaves contact across neighboring eastern languages open.
